kehillah_lib_acquire_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
		kehillah_lib_can_commission_trigger = yes
		var:kehillah_own_library ?= {
			NOT = { has_variable_list = kehillah_library_commission_work }
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_acquisition_candidates target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_commission_work_loc value = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_commission_work value = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
		trigger_event = kehillah_library.0002
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
		kehillah_lib_can_commission_trigger = yes
		var:kehillah_own_library ?= {
			NOT = { has_variable_list = kehillah_library_commission_work }
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_acquisition_candidates target = flag:work_authored_90 }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_90 } }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_commission_work_loc value = flag:work_authored_90 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_commission_work value = flag:work_authored_90 }
		trigger_event = kehillah_library.0002
	}
}
